{{Otheruses|Operations Chief}}
'''Battle Station Operations Chief''' was the rank given to the [[Officer/Legends|officer]] charged with overseeing [[Battle Station Operations/Legends|Battle Station Operations]] aboard the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|first]] [[Death Star/Legends|Death Star]]. [[General/Legends|General]] [[Hurst Romodi/Legends|Hurst Romodi]] held this position.
